title: Screens at home, science in action
instructionsHu: Nézd meg a két kép leírását. Írd le, hogyan használják az emberek a technikát, hasonlítsd össze a két képet, majd válaszolj a vizsgáztató kérdéseire.

scenes.description: A family of four is sitting in their living room on a Sunday evening. The parents are on the sofa, both looking at their phones, and the two children are sitting on the floor with tablets and headphones. The TV is on, but nobody is watching it. Nobody is talking, and the room is quite dark.

A group of children aged about twelve are at a robotics workshop in a science centre. They are building a small robot from colourful parts on a big table, and a young instructor is showing a girl how to connect the wires. On a screen behind them there is a picture of a robot on Mars. The children look excited and are discussing their ideas.

prompts: Describe what the people are doing with technology.
How is technology used differently in the two pictures?
Which picture shows a better way to use technology? Why?
followUpQuestions: How much time does your family spend on screens in the evening?
Have you ever been to a science centre or museum? What did you see?
Would you like to build a robot or learn programming? Why?
Do you think children use phones too much these days?
What rules about phones are there in your home or at your school?

usefulPhrases.en: They're all staring at their screens.
Nobody is paying attention to the others.
Technology can bring people together or keep them apart.
usefulPhrases.hu: A technika összehozhatja vagy elszigetelheti az embereket.
